# Captured kickoff-brief entries

Each file here is a sign-off or amendment-log entry copied verbatim from the
commit that landed it in a real bundle's `kickoff-brief.md`. They are captured
output, never hand-authored goldens: `tests/test-kickoff-verification-homes.sh`
re-derives every file from its landing commit and fails on any divergence, so
an edit here that is not a re-capture is caught.
